messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: Technology Transfer Block Exemption - what's changed
messages.plaintextBody: Join us on Thursday 22 January, 12:30-13:30, in the Bishopsgate training suite (sandwiches provided) for a CPD session on the EU Technology Transfer Block Exemption Regulation and its implications for licensing deals. 1 hour CPD. Register with Knowledge & Learning.
